title: F3 follow-up: F2 turn-boundary expiry integration
description: expireElapsedRoundEffects evaluates round-unit timers at round granularity (deadline = anchor_round + amount) and is currently invoked explicitly. F2 integration work: (1) begin_turn should auto-sweep elapsed round effects so expiry never depends on the model remembering to call it; (2) the 'trigger-occurred', 'source-turn-start', and 'target-turn-start' anchor kinds are schema-reserved and REFUSED at creation/refresh (PR #437 review: the engine must not stamp anchors it cannot evaluate) — implementing them needs the F2 turn event (participant + turns_taken window, same token pattern as F5 recharge) plus a durable trigger/actor reference on the anchor, then removing them from the refusal list and adding them to the tool schema enum. See docs/active-effect-lifecycle.md §3 and SUPPORTED_EFFECT_ANCHOR_KINDS in state/activeEffects.ts.
close_reason: Implemented F2 turn-boundary expiry integration with durable F3 anchor evidence and begin_turn settlement
